answer: An agent market can resist Sybil attacks with a slashable identity bond backed by peer vouchers. A velvet rope of admission means every trader locks real collateral before it earns a name, and vouchers are signed, so a raven cloning itself still needs one fresh deposit and one honest guarantor per fake. Each ledger delta is checked against that deposit, and a discovered twin is slashed. Minting a hundred shells therefore costs a hundred bonds, all forfeited on detection.
